title: blond
summary: A collection of several hundred short blonde jokes, mostly in question-and-answer form, with a handful of longer anecdotes and one-liners. The jokes follow the familiar pattern of the 'dumb blonde' stereotype: riddles such as 'What do you call a blonde with half a brain?' are answered with punchlines built on wordplay, double meanings and crude sexual innuendo. Topics range from hair, cars and household chores to pregnancy, the workplace and bar-room stock gags, and some entries are repeated with minor variations. Several longer tales appear too, including a blonde who drives the wrong way and a trio of blondes trying to change a light bulb. The text is heavy with profanity and explicit sexual references, and the jokes are offensive by modern standards, though they are typical of the once-popular blonde-joke genre that circulated in print and online. No author or compiler is credited in the text, so the collection appears to be an anonymous compilation of folk humour.
